mapper.select: SELECT CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'elder_pending' WHEN 1 THEN 'elder_in' WHEN 2 THEN 'elder_out' ELSE 'elder_other' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM elder_info WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY status

SELECT CASE bed_status WHEN 0 THEN 'bed_free' WHEN 1 THEN 'bed_used' WHEN 2 THEN 'bed_maint' ELSE 'bed_other' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bed WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY bed_status

SELECT CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 'visit_pending' ELSE 'visit_done' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visit_record WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 'user_ok' ELSE 'user_disabled' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status

SELECT CASE WHEN bill_type IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 'bill_main' ELSE 'bill_other' END AS label, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM bill_detail WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY CASE WHEN bill_type IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(nursing_level_name), ''), 'nursing_uncat') AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM check_in WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(nursing_level_name), ''), 'nursing_uncat')

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 1 AND IFNULL(age, 0) < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m0, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 1 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 60 AND 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 1 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m2, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 1 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 1 AND IFNULL(age, 0) > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m4, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 2 AND IFNULL(age, 0) < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w0, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 2 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 60 AND 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w1, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 2 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w2, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 2 AND IFNULL(age, 0) BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w3, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 2 AND IFNULL(age, 0) > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS w4 FROM elder_info WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)

SELECT CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS type, DATE_FORMAT(visit_time, '%H:%i') AS time, visitor_name AS name, visitor_phone AS phone FROM visit_record WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND DATE(visit_time) = #{day} ORDER BY visit_time ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS type, DATE_FORMAT(visit_time, '%H:%i') AS time, visitor_name AS name, visitor_phone AS phone FROM visit_record WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND visit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(visit_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY visit_time ASC

SELECT HOUR(pay_time) AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amt FROM bill_detail WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pay_time) = #{day} GROUP BY HOUR(pay_time)

SELECT HOUR(create_time) AS hr, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amt FROM bill_detail WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND pay_status = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(create_time) = #{day} GROUP BY HOUR(create_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amt FROM bill_detail WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND pay_status = 1 AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pay_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(pay_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amt FROM bill_detail WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND pay_status = 0 AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM check_in WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(start_date) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(start_date)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM check_in WHERE status = 1 AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(end_date) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(end_date)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visit_record WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND visit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(visit_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(visit_time)
SELECT HOUR(start_date) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM check_in WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(start_date) = #{day} GROUP BY HOUR(start_date)
SELECT HOUR(end_date) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM check_in WHERE status = 1 AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(end_date) = #{day} GROUP BY HOUR(end_date)
